title: Whoever, Whichever, Wherever
goal: Say whoever, whichever and wherever with cualquiera que, quienquiera que and dondequiera que + subjunctive.
grammar: Universal relatives: cualquiera que, quienquiera que, dondequiera que

items: I can say whoever, whichever and wherever with quienquiera que, cualquiera que and dondequiera que.
I can use the subjunctive after these words, because the choice is open.
I can use the new words for the door and messages.
